page.overview:
Who is "Ashcan" Pete?

"Ashcan" Pete Washburne, the Drifter, is a fictional character created by Fantasy Flight Games for their Arkham Horror Files line of Cthulhu Mythos content. He made his first appearance in the Core Set of Arkham Horror Second Edition.

Pete is a drifter, travelling the country with his trusty dog Duke and his guitar. He has roamed the length and breadth of the United States, but his nightmares have finally led him to the New England town of Arkham, where he hopes to put an end to the bad dreams.

Since his debut in Arkham Horror Second Edition, Pete has appeared in a number of Arkham Horror Files works, including the Arkham Horror: The Card Game expansion The Dunwich Legacy, the Eldritch Horror expansion Cities in Ruin, and the Mansions of Madness expansion Recurring Nightmares. He also made a cameo appearance in Graham McNeill's 2011 novel Ghouls of the Miskatonic, and in 2010 a pre-painted plastic miniature of the character was released as part of the Arkham Horror Premium Figures line.
